target: Pilih dulu klinik terdekat sebagai tempat berobat pertama kamu.
english: First choose the nearest clinic as your primary place for treatment.
tip: Ber- + a noun can mean going to get it: obat (medicine) gives berobat, to seek treatment. Tempat berobat = the place you go to get treated.

target: Kamar pasien BPJS sekarang mulai disamakan lewat kelas rawat inap standar.
english: BPJS patient rooms are now starting to be standardized through the standard inpatient class.
tip: KRIS (kelas rawat inap standar) is replacing the old kelas 1–3 — one standard room class for all.

target: Kartu ATM dan buku tabungan diberikan langsung hari itu juga.
english: The ATM card and savings book are handed over that very same day.
tip: Hari itu juga = that very same day. Juga after a time phrase adds 'right then'.

target: Jangan kasih tahu nomor PIN kamu ke siapa pun, termasuk petugas bank.
english: Don't tell your PIN number to anyone at all, including bank staff.
tip: Siapa pun = anyone at all: jangan kasih tahu siapa pun = don't tell anyone. Pun strengthens.

target: Kartu ATM saya tertelan mesin, jadi harus melapor ke kantor cabang.
english: My ATM card got swallowed by the machine, so I have to report it to the branch office.
tip: Ter- marks accidents: tertelan = accidentally swallowed (by the machine), ketinggalan = left behind.

target: Simpan bukti transfer sampai uangnya benar-benar masuk.
english: Keep the transfer receipt until the money has really arrived.
tip: Benar-benar = really, truly: benar-benar masuk = has really arrived. Doubling intensifies.

target: Teman saya kena denda karena tinggal lewat dari batas visanya.
english: My friend got fined for staying past his visa limit.
tip: Kena = to get hit with (bad things): kena denda = get fined, kena flu = catch the flu.

target: Proses perpanjangan visa makan waktu sekitar lima hari kerja.
english: The visa extension process takes about five working days.
tip: Makan waktu = to take time (lit. eat time): prosesnya makan waktu lima hari = it takes five days.

target: Syarat daftar SD antara lain akta kelahiran dan kartu keluarga.
english: The requirements for elementary school registration include a birth certificate and the family card.
tip: Antara lain introduces a partial list – 'among others': syarat antara lain akta kelahiran dan kartu keluarga means those plus more not named.

target: Anak yang diterima harus mendaftar ulang paling lambat hari Jumat.
english: Children who are accepted have to re-register by Friday at the latest.
tip: Daftar ulang = re-register to claim your seat (ulang = again). Miss it and the spot is gone.

target: Sekolah meminta pas foto anak ukuran tiga kali empat, dua lembar.
english: The school asked for two of the child's ID photos, size three by four.
tip: Pas foto = ID photo; sizes are in cm: tiga kali empat = 3x4. Standard for every form.

target: Kami sekeluarga memakai baju merah putih saat acara tujuh belasan di kompleks.
english: Our whole family wears red-and-white clothes during the Independence Day event at the complex.
tip: Tujuh belasan is tujuh belas (17) plus -an – the suffix turns the date into the whole event: any August 17 festivity is acara tujuh belasan.

target: Spanduk bertuliskan Dirgahayu Republik Indonesia digantung di depan kantor kelurahan.
english: A banner reading 'Long Live the Republic of Indonesia' is hung in front of the ward office.
tip: Dirgahayu = 'long live', banner language: Dirgahayu Republik Indonesia.

target: Adik saya baru belajar puasa setengah hari tahun ini.
english: My little sibling is just learning to fast half a day this year.
tip: Before a verb, baru means 'only just', not 'new': baru belajar puasa = is only just learning to fast. As 'new', baru follows its noun instead.

target: Adik langsung membeli sepatu baru begitu THR ayah cair.
english: My little sibling buys new shoes right away as soon as Dad's holiday bonus comes through.
tip: Cair is literally 'liquid'; for money it means paid out: THR ayah cair = Dad's bonus came through. Salaries and funds cair when they land.

target: Kami mengucapkan mohon maaf lahir dan batin kepada semua saudara.
english: We say 'forgive me, outwardly and inwardly' to all our relatives.
tip: Mohon maaf lahir dan batin is the fixed Lebaran formula: 'forgive my wrongs, outward and inner' – lahir is the outward side, batin the inner.

target: Menurut berita, arus balik tahun ini lebih padat daripada arus mudik.
english: According to the news, this year's return traffic is heavier than the outbound exodus.
tip: Arus mudik = the outbound exodus; arus balik = the return wave. News-speak you'll hear daily.

target: Tiket kereta untuk mudik habis terjual dalam beberapa jam saja.
english: Train tickets for the homecoming sold out in just a few hours.
tip: The ter- in terjual means it happened with no doer named: habis terjual is literally 'used up, got sold' – sold out.

target: Anak-anak yang belum menikah menerima angpao dari om dan tante mereka.
english: Children who are not yet married receive red envelopes from their uncles and aunts.
tip: The angpao rule: married adults give the red envelopes, the unmarried receive – which is why the card says belum menikah. Marriage flips your role.

target: Kantor teman saya libur dua hari karena ada cuti bersama setelah hari raya Imlek.
english: My friend's office is off for two days because there is a joint leave day after Imlek.
tip: Cuti bersama is government-set shared leave glued onto a holiday – the whole kantor closes on those dates whether you asked for leave or not.

target: Kembang api menyala di langit kota tepat jam dua belas malam.
english: Fireworks light up the city sky exactly at twelve o'clock at night.
tip: Spoken time uses jam: jam dua belas malam = 12 at night. Pukul is for announcements.

target: Sehari setelah Nyepi, warga saling berkunjung untuk bermaaf-maafan.
english: The day after Nyepi, residents visit one another to exchange apologies.
tip: Doubling inside ber-...-an makes it mutual: bermaaf-maafan = forgive one another. Saling berkunjung uses saling = each other for the same job.

target: Menurut kebiasaan kantor, yang berulang tahun wajib mentraktir teman-temannya.
english: By office custom, whoever has a birthday must treat their friends.
tip: The birthday custom runs in reverse: yang berulang tahun wajib mentraktir – the birthday person treats everyone else, not the other way around.

target: Sirup obat batuk ini harus dikocok dulu sebelum diminum.
english: This cough syrup has to be shaken first before being drunk.
tip: Dulu after a verb = 'first': dikocok dulu sebelum diminum = shaken first before drinking.

target: Salep ini dioleskan tipis-tipis pada kulit yang gatal dua kali sehari.
english: This ointment is applied thinly on the itchy skin twice a day.
tip: Doubling an adjective = 'in that manner': dioleskan tipis-tipis = spread on thinly.

target: Kalau demamnya tidak turun dalam tiga hari, segera periksakan ke dokter.
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days, have it checked by a doctor right away.
tip: -kan can mean 'have it done': periksa = examine, periksakan ke dokter = have it examined by a doctor. You arrange the action, someone else performs it.

target: Tolong panggil ambulans, ayah saya tiba-tiba jatuh pingsan di kamar mandi!
english: Please call an ambulance, my father suddenly fainted in the bathroom!
tip: Tolong + verb = please (asking for help): tolong panggil ambulans = please call an ambulance.

target: Nomor darurat di Indonesia adalah satu satu dua, mudah diingat.
english: The emergency number in Indonesia is one-one-two, easy to remember.
tip: Numbers you dial are read digit by digit: 112 = satu satu dua, never seratus dua belas.

target: Kalau ada kebakaran, jangan memakai lift, turunlah lewat tangga darurat.
english: If there's a fire, don't use the elevator; go down via the emergency stairs.
tip: -lah softens a command: turunlah lewat tangga = do go down the stairs.

target: Untung ada tetangga yang mengantar kami ke rumah sakit tengah malam.
english: Luckily there was a neighbor who drove us to the hospital in the middle of the night.
tip: Untung at the start of a sentence = luckily: untung ada tetangga = luckily there was a neighbor.
